item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Charu's sketch of a familiar seven-star pattern. She joins the bright stars with pencil lines so classmates can recognise the shape.

What do those pencil lines represent?

options.A: An identification pattern drawn to recognise the star group, not real solid lines in the sky.
options.B: Real glowing threads stretched between stars in space.
options.C: Only the stars on the pencil lines belong to the constellation; nearby unmarked stars in the same sky region do not.
options.D: The lines are real if drawn solid and imaginary only if drawn dotted.
